title: Why Slow Drains Happen: The Root Cause in Drainage Systems
description: Understanding the root cause of a slow-running drain goes beyond simply reaching for a chemical cleaner. In most drainage systems, restrictions start small where hair, grease, and soap scum accumulate against pipe fittings or minor pipe imperfections. Over time, this buildup narrows the internal diameter of the pipe, reducing flow velocity and eventually causing complete blockages. Professional troubleshooting involves identifying where the restriction occurs, understanding how venting affects drainage speed, and applying mechanical clearing methods that protect pipe integrity instead of relying on corrosive chemical treatments.
